prompt_text:
Task: Hosted LLM Inference and Model-Family Selection

Write code that calls a hosted LLM to summarize long text using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Granite via watsonx.ai:
  Service: watsonx.ai text chat
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text/chat
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/watsonx-ai-cp

Option 2 — Qwen via DashScope:
  Service: DashScope Qwen API
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Generation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen-api

Option 3 — Mistral:
  Service: Mistral Chat API
  SDK: mistralai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: chat.complete
  Setup hints: MISTRAL_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.mistral.ai/api/

Option 4 — Anthropic:
  Service: Anthropic Messages API
  SDK: anthropic
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: messages.create
  Setup hints: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages

Option 5 — Gemini API:
  Service: Google Gemini API
  SDK: google-genai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: models.generate_content
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/text-generation

Option 6 — Amazon Nova/Titan via Bedrock:
  Service: Amazon Bedrock Runtime
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: invoke_model, converse
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/boto3/latest/reference/services/bedrock-runtime/client/invoke_model.html

Option 7 — GPT via OpenAI/Azure OpenAI:
  Service: OpenAI / Azure OpenAI chat completions
  SDK: openai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: chat.completions.create
  Setup hints: OPENAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
```python
import os
from ibm_watsonx_ai import CpWatsonxaiServiceClient
from ibm_watsonx_ai.llm.chat_messages import ChatMessage
from ibm_watsonx_ai.llm.chat_result import ChatResult
from ibm_cloud_sdk_core.authenticators import IAMAuthenticator

def summarize_text(text: str, provider: str = "watsonx.ai") -> str:
    """
    Summarizes long text using a hosted LLM.

    Args:
        text (str): The text to summarize.
        provider (str): The LLM provider to use. Default is "watsonx.ai".
                        Supported providers: "watsonx.ai", "dashscope", "mistralai",
                                             "anthropic", "google-genai", "boto3",
                                             "openai".

    Returns:
        str: The summarized text.
    """
    if provider == "watsonx.ai":
        # Watsonx.ai
        api_key = os.getenv("WATSONX_API_KEY")
        project_id = os.getenv("WATSONX_PROJECT_ID")
        authenticator = IAMAuthenticator(api_key)
        client = CpWatsonxaiServiceClient(authenticator=authenticator)
        chat_result: ChatResult = client.chat(
            input_text=text,
            project_id=project_id,
            model_id="predibase-mistral-philosopher-v0.1-instruct",
            max_output_tokens=150,
        ).get_result()
        return chat_result.choices[0].message.content

    elif provider == "dashscope":
        # DashScope
        api_key = os.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY")
        client = Client(api_key=api_key)
        response = client.generation.call(
            model="Qwen2.5-110B-Chat",
            messages=[ChatMessage(role="user", content=text)],
        )
        return response.choices[0].message.content

    elif provider == "mistralai":
        # Mistral
        api_key = os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY")
        client = MistralClient(api_key=api_key)
        response = client.chat.completions.create(
            model="mistral-large-2402-beta",
            messages=[ChatMessage(role="user", content=text)],
            max_tokens=150,
        )
        return response.choices[0].message.content

    elif provider == "anthropic":
        # Anthropic
        api_key = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
        client = Client(api_key=api_key)
        response = client.messages.create(
            model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620",
            max_tokens=150,
            messages=[ChatMessage(role="user", content=text)],
        )
        return response.choices[0].message.content

    elif provider == "google-genai":
        # Google Gemini
        api_key = os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
        client = GenAI(api_key=api_key)
        model = client.beta.models.get("gemini-1.5-pro")
        response = model.generate_content(text, generation_config=GenerationConfig(max_output_tokens=150))
        return response.text

    elif provider == "boto3":
        # Amazon Bedrock
        aws_access_key_id = os.getenv("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID")
        aws_secret_access_key = os.getenv("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY")
        bedrock = boto3.client(
            "bedrock-runtime",
            region_name="us-east-1",
            aws_access_key_id=aws_access_key_id,
            aws_secret_access_key=aws_secret_access_key,
        )
        response = bedrock.invoke_model(
            body=json.dumps({"prompt": text}),
            contentType="application/json",
            modelId="anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0",
        )
        return json.loads(response["body"].read())["generations"][0]["text"]

    elif provider == "openai":
        # OpenAI / Azure OpenAI
        api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
        client = ChatClient(api_key=api_key)
        response = client.chat.completions.create(
            model="gpt-4o",
            messages=[ChatMessage(role="user", content=text)],
            max_tokens=150,
        )
        return response.choices[0].message.content

    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported provider: {provider}")
```
